body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn; you gain +1 Fortitude against that target during the same time.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit toward or away from it.
On a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When the target misses an attack before your next turn, it may either stay in place and become Slowed 2, or move 1 unit away from you; both expire at your next turn.
